title: Nebula Grid Definition
description: Declarative schema for a Nebula admin grid. Files live at view/adminhtml/grid/<id>.json and are deep-merged across modules by the definition resolver. A file MAY be a `base` (contains `id` + `columns` + `dataSource`) or an `overlay` (omits `id` and only contributes a subset of keys that are merged onto the base).

id.title: Grid identifier
id.description: Unique snake_case identifier. Base files MUST set this and it MUST match the file name (without .json). Overlay files MUST omit it.

acl.title: ACL resource
acl.description: Magento ACL resource required to access the grid. Format: Vendor_Module::resource.

dataSource.title: Data source
dataSource.description: Where the grid rows come from.

settings.title: Grid settings
settings.description: Pagination, default sort, toolbar and add-button configuration.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Map of column_id -> column definition. Render order is controlled by the numeric `position` on each column.

oneOf.title: Overlay fragment
oneOf.description: An overlay contributed by another module. Must NOT set `id`.

dataSource.title: Grid data source
dataSource.description: A data provider alias plus optional provider-specific config.

provider.title: Data provider alias
provider.description: Alias registered in DataProviderRegistry (e.g. catalog.product.grid). FQCNs are rejected — register an alias in your module's etc/di.xml.

config.title: Provider config
config.description: Free-form map forwarded to the provider. Well-known keys: collection, attributes, method, identifierParam.

collection.title: Collection FQCN
collection.description: For the generic CollectionProvider: the Magento Collection class to instantiate.

attributes.title: Attributes to load
attributes.description: Attribute codes to eager-load onto each row.

method.title: Collection method
method.description: Optional collection method to invoke after creation (e.g. addTaxClass).

identifierParam.title: Identifier request param
identifierParam.description: Request parameter name carrying the row id.

pageSize.title: Default page size
pageSize.description: Number of rows rendered per page by default.

pageSizes.title: Page size options
pageSizes.description: Values offered in the page-size picker.

field.title: Sort field
field.description: Column id the grid sorts by when first opened.

massActions.title: Mass actions
massActions.description: Either false (disabled) or an array of mass-action descriptors.

addButton.title: Add button
addButton.description: Primary toolbar button. Either a single-URL button or a dropdown of options.

url.title: Target URL
url.description: Admin route to navigate to on click. Mutually exclusive with `options`.

options.title: Dropdown options
options.description: When set, the button renders as a split dropdown. Mutually exclusive with `url`.

id.title: Action id
id.description: Unique id for the mass action.

label.title: Label
label.description: Button label shown in the toolbar.

url.title: Submit URL
url.description: Admin route the selected ids POST to.

confirm.title: Confirm message
confirm.description: If set, shown in a confirmation dialog before submission.

column.title: Column
column.description: A column definition. Every column needs either a built-in `type` or a `renderer` (a snippet reference).

label.title: Header label
label.description: Column header text. Empty string is allowed for the trailing actions column.

type.title: Built-in column type
type.description: One of the built-in column renderers. Mutually exclusive with `renderer`.

renderer.title: Snippet renderer
renderer.description: Reference to a snippet that renders the cell, e.g. snippet.custom_renderer. For simple static option sets use type:badge with inline options instead. Mutually exclusive with `type`.

position.title: Position
position.description: Integer controlling column order. Lower numbers render first. Use 999 for the trailing actions column.

sortable.title: Sortable
sortable.description: Whether the column header toggles sort on click.

searchable.title: Searchable
searchable.description: Whether the global search box includes this column.

filter.title: Filter widget
filter.description: Which filter widget to render under the header. `false` disables filtering.

filterOptions.title: Inline filter options
filterOptions.description: For filter=select: map of value -> label rendered as-is.

filterOptionsSource.title: Filter options source alias
filterOptionsSource.description: For filter=select: alias registered in FilterOptionSourceRegistry (e.g. magento.store.system). FQCNs are rejected — register an alias in etc/di.xml.

options.title: Badge options
options.description: For type=badge: map of cell value -> {label, class}. Convention: for simple static option sets (status, enabled/disabled, visibility) declare options inline here instead of using renderer: snippet.*. Dynamic option sets should use filterOptionsSource.

actions.title: Row actions
actions.description: For type=actions: list of row-level links.

url.title: Action URL template
url.description: May contain {{field}} placeholders substituted from the row.
